The selected contractor will be responsible for navigating with a GPS unit to stay within the project boundaries. The Government will only be on site for periodic work inspection. Start and end points for treatment will not be identified on the ground. The Contractor will need to use a map in conjunction with a GPS that has land ownership layer and/or ability to utilize a geo-referencing program that allows the Contractor to determine where they are located within the project. Only BLM land is allowed to be treated under this contract. The Contractor is responsible for determining that the treated area is within the correct area and on BLM-administered land only. The Contractor should not treat any areas on private land under this contract. Minor boundary adjustments to treatment units, up to 15% of the total project area, may occur for administrative purposes during project implementation that would potentially change the size or shape of treatment units. The exhibits shall translate the Government's approved artistic and interpretive vision into engaging, technically reliable, museum-quality visitor experiences. 2. GENERAL INFORMATION A. Introduction and Background The U. S. Geological Survey (USGS) Earthquake Science Center, Seattle Field Office (SFO), requests laboratory services for tree ring samples collected from paleoseismological and landslide studies in the Pacific Northwest. Paleoseismologists and geologists conduct studies of active fault zones and lands

e Pacific Northwest. Paleoseismologists and geologists conduct studies of active fault zones and landslides throughout the Pacific Northwest. An integral part of these studies are tree ring analyses to determine precise ages of past earthquakes and coseismically- triggered landslides. The USGS does not have the in-house capabilities to provide proper sample collection, preparation, processing, and final analysis. C. Scope The purpose of the laboratory work is to provide support services and the preparation and processing of wood samples for tree ring and isotope analyses. We anticipate needing analyses on up to 20 tree samples (core or slabs containing ring series of hundreds of rings). The criteria for acceptance of services shall be finished wood preparation, dissection of rings, radiocarbon and isotope analyses, and preparation and analysis of individual growth increments and analysis results for cross-dating analysis. The methods now also use oxygen isotopes as a means for cross-dating samples in addition to radiocarbon and traditional dendrochrologic techniques, resulting in a multi-proxy, cross-validated geochronologic process. he Carson Ranger District in Washoe County, Nevada. LOCATION AND DESCRIPTION: 1.1 The project is in Washoe County, Nevada shown on attached location Map 1. This SOW is only for the locations within National Forest System lands. PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: 2.1 Contract Time: Work would be done in late summer/fall months from August to November prior to germination of medusahead and rattail six weeks grass. The yellow starthistle seedbank will also be captured during this treatment window. Work will be timed according to weather conditions and plant phenology and may be adjusted if weather conditions, or plant phenology require a change. award_criteria.text: A Commercial Solutions Opening W912CH- 25-S-C001. The Center for Army Analysis (CAA) seeks proposals for an innovative Information Technology (IT) services solution to enhance agency-wide IT and desktop support across its internally managed classified Closed Restricted Network (CRN) and its externally managed classified and unclassified network environments. Offerors shall provide a detailed narrative demonstrating their organizational capacity and a proven record of delivering effective, efficient support services comparable in scope to this requirement. The narrative must include specific examples of service delivery models, internal quality control measures, and a summary of historical performance metrics achieved for clients of comparable size and complexity. This CSO AoI seeks to solicit innovative solutions that meet the objectives detailed in Sections 1.2 and 1.3. The term innovative is defined as any technology, process, or method, including research and development that is new as of the date of proposal submission, or any new application of an existing technology, process or method as of the proposal date. Offerors are encouraged to submit multiple options. ACC-DTA is not obligated to extend a request for proposal or make an award as a result of this CSO AoI; all awards are subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. This CSO AoI is not an authorization to begin performance, and in no way obligates the Government for any costs incurred by the Offeror associated with developing a Response. Prior to commencement of any activities associated with performance under this CSO AoI, the Government will issue a written directive or contractual document signed by the Contracting Officer with appropriate consideration established. The Government will evaluate the quoter’s ability to meet the following requirements of the solicitation: The Government will evaluate the Quoters demonstrated capability to provide Medical Grade Gas supplies as a primary business function. The Government will assess whether Medical Grade Gas supplies are clearly established as the quoter’s principal line of business. The Government will evaluate any proposed subcontracting and determine whether the level of subcontracted work presents a pass-through risk.
